prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 2024年夏季奥运会奖牌榜（前12） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 13 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "排名" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 31px
  col 2: header "国家 / 地区" · longest unbreakable unit 63px · widest one-line content 122px
  col 3: header "金牌" · longest unbreakable unit 19px · widest one-line content 31px
  col 4: header "銀牌" · longest unbreakable unit 19px · widest one-line content 31px
  col 5: header "銅牌" · longest unbreakable unit 19px · widest one-line content 31px
  col 6: header "总计" · longest unbreakable unit 25px · widest one-line content 31px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The column widths must sum to at most 359px: the table must fit; no horizontal scrolling.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.
